raw_idea: Pharmacy POS for inventory and billing

intent.primary_goal: Pharmacy POS for inventory and billing
intent.problem_statement: Managing pharmacy inventory, sales, and prescription handling efficiently.

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Track stock levels, reorder points, and item batches

features.name: Billing & POS
features.description: Process sales transactions, taxes, and receipt generation

features.name: Prescription Tracking
features.description: Record doctor prescriptions and patient dispensation history

constraints.description: Offline-first billing with local SQLite cache

assumptions.assumption: Application requires secure transaction recording and audit logs
assumptions.evidence_basis: Inferred from POS / financial domain requirements

unknowns.question: Who are the primary people using this application (e.g. pharmacists, cashiers, store owners, or general consumers)?
unknowns.answer: Single pharmacy location, offline billing needed, for pharmacists and cashiers, mobile Android

unknowns.question: Does billing need to function offline without an active internet connection?
Should the MVP support prescription tracking and doctor details, or only general retail products?
Is this for a single store/pharmacy location or multiple branches with centralized reporting?
What platform will users access this on (Web browser, Mobile Android/iOS, or Desktop application)?
